calls.reason: The packet contains no independent evaluation of the reflexive prompt on the June 2022 model. The later DALL-E 2 study concerns a different model and was coauthored by Marcus.

Li, Nye and Andreas found updating but error-prone representations; Toshniwal et al. demonstrated accurate chess state tracking. These challenge the broad wording but leave reliable use in the intended scope unclear.
This is an explicitly tentative causal interpretation. Kaplan et al. document prediction-focused research, but provide no evidence that it displaced cognitive-model theory.

Lialin et al. report zero-shot composition failures, while Zhou et al. achieve 99.7% on SCAN with structured prompting. The mixed results do not clearly settle the broad claim that foundation models sidestep compositionality.
The DALL-E 2 paper documents cube-color binding difficulties, but gives no reversal rate for Marcus's prompt. His probabilistic wording and the missing frequency evidence leave the claim uncallable.

TruthfulQA documents false answers, and WebGPT and InstructGPT show partial improvements with residual errors. None establishes that missing world representations cause the errors, leaving the full causal claim unsettled.
